# Vendored code

`lame.min.js` is vendored from `zhuker/lamejs` release/tag `1.2.1`.

Verified upstream Git blob:

`8dc6b0726388ff75bec69ac55ac5a6cc49e61093`

The adjacent `LICENSE.lamejs` is byte-identical to the upstream license at the same tag (Git blob `e456b65d30e5df56ba66cef91716bdc35085463e`).

The browser loads this copy from the same GitHub Pages origin; no executable JavaScript is fetched from a third-party CDN at runtime.
